data.answer: Evidence shows a first short started at ~90 s [claim_cabe39c1b6] and recovered at ~215 s [claim_3e9cecfa06], and a second short started at ~351 s [claim_ede7c5f8a6], indicating reversible shorting during the experiment. Filament growth speed could not be quantified because no recorded outlines were available.
data.not_proven: Filament growth rate, whether filaments fully bridged the electrolyte at the moment of shorting, and whether retraction caused recovery could not be proven without measurable filament outlines.
